name: Drawing Register
office_task: Keep every machine drawing on our drive on one register with an owner and its current revision, find the page an electrician needs, and tell the owner when a drawing changes.
systems_of_record: the shared drive that holds the drawings and issues the document_id (Google Drive or SharePoint), left where it is
the drawing register on that tenant (one Sheet or SharePoint list: a row per source, owner a person, kind, revision and checksum)
the task list the business runs (Google Tasks, Planner or a sheet), which issues the exception_id for each gap

emits.write: a task on the business's task list naming the person who owns it, with a due date: a drawing revision the register expects and the drive does not hold, a file whose only owner is a team, two copies of one drawing waiting for a person to pick the canonical one, customer material waiting for someone to set who may read it and for how long, an instrument with no revision on its title block, or a registered file gone from the drive
emits.readback: the task list returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns what is expected, the owner and the due date; no id back means nothing was raised, and the file stays off the index
